career_goals: Become a Backend Engineer, Master Data Analytics

expected_output.summary: String (brief overview explaining how this path fits the user’s goals and skill level)
expected_output.recommended_next_skill: String (the most logical next skill that builds on current_skill)
expected_output.reasoning: String (why this next skill makes sense based on goals and skill in current_performance block)
expected_output.difficulty: String (should logically be relevant to the details in the input block)

constraints: current_skill is skill in current_performance block.
recommended_next_skill must be a natural next step after current_skill.
summary and reasoning must be clear, short, and practical.
Difficulty should progress logically without skipping levels.
All output fields must be non-null and match expected_output structure.
Exclude markdown or any formatting syntax; output must be pure JSON.
Generated next_skill must be based on skill and correspond with performance in current_performance block
Always output a single JSON object with the exact expected_output fields.
recommended_activities should from 1 to 4, list the most impactful and varied activities for developing input skill.
Ensure all references in 'resources' block are highly relevant and high quality.
Ensure all references are unique and varied in nature.
Ensure all links provided are relevant, working correctly, and pointing to the resource intended.
If a link for a resource type is unavailable, replace with text based resource.
